_comment: Shape reference for team.json. This file is not rendered anywhere.
A member with a non-empty 'links' array renders in the two-column layout
(biography beside a Connect list); an empty 'links' array renders full width.
'bio' and 'background' entries may contain raw HTML - they are output with | safe.
'image' is resolved against src/, e.g. /images/team/name.jpg. Use
/images/team/placeholder.svg until a real portrait is available.

bio: First paragraph. May contain links and emphasis.
